summary: The most consequential problem is that the septic arthritis rule drops 'single joint' and 'short history', so ordinary acute gout or polyarticular flares become probable septic arthritis and Urgent. Also, because Gonococcal infection of joint is a descendant of Infective arthritis, the flowchart's gonococcal diagnosis triggers Urgent too. The red-box gout rule omits the surgery and intra-articular-injection exclusions; the flowchart branches are otherwise faithfully encoded, apart from a few minor gaps (recent injury, the rash negation, the 6-week boundary).
